market.question: Will Crude Oil (CL) hit (HIGH) $115 by end of June?

assessment.reasoning: WTI crude trading near $93-100 with intraday low of $88.71 on May 7 amid Iran de-escalation talks. Reaching $115 by end of June requires ~15-23% rally in ~8 weeks. Geopolitical de-escalation makes this very unlikely; would need supply shock reversal.
assessment.key_uncertainty: Iran deal collapse or major supply disruption
